requirement.text: In service critical or human relating features only explainable AI/ML solutions are used. When requested the system can provide reasoning behind given result.

initial_eus.title: Explainable AI in Service-Critical and Human-Related Features
initial_eus.description: As a user, I want the system to provide the reasoning behind a result on request, so that I can understand how the result was reached.
work_items: Only explainable AI/ML solutions are used in service-critical features.
Only explainable AI/ML solutions are used in features relating to humans.
When requested, the system provides the reasoning behind a given result.

analysis.ethical_objective: Ensure transparency and explainability of AI/ML used in service-critical or human-related features, so that the reasoning behind results can be provided to those who request it.

obligations.text: Only explainable AI/ML solutions shall be used in service-critical or human-related features.
obligations.source_span: In service critical or human relating features only explainable AI/ML solutions are used.

obligations.text: Upon request, the system shall provide the reasoning behind a given result.
obligations.source_span: When requested the system can provide reasoning behind given result.

constraints: The restriction to explainable AI/ML solutions applies to service-critical or human-related features.
Reasoning behind a result is to be provided on request rather than unconditionally.
ambiguities: The source does not define what qualifies as 'explainable' AI/ML.
The source does not define which features count as 'service critical' or 'human relating'.
The source does not specify who may request reasoning (e.g., end users, affected individuals, operators, auditors).
The source does not specify what 'reasoning behind given result' must contain or at what level of detail.
It is unclear whether the ability to provide reasoning applies only to service-critical or human-related features or to all AI/ML results.
The phrasing 'can provide' is ambiguous between a required capability and a discretionary option.
unsupported_assumptions_to_avoid: Do not assume specific explainability techniques or model types are required.
Do not assume a particular format, medium, or level of detail for the reasoning provided.
Do not assume timing or response-time requirements for providing reasoning.
Do not assume the requester is limited to a particular stakeholder group.
Do not assume that reasoning must be tailored to non-expert comprehension.
Do not assume that explanations must be logged, stored, or audited.
Do not assume that features outside the stated scope are exempt from other transparency expectations.
Do not assume any specific legal or regulatory basis for the requirement.
possible_operational_aspects: Applicability depends on whether a feature is service-critical or human-related.
Provision of reasoning is triggered by a request.
The reasoning provided relates to a specific given result.

work_items.explanation: Expresses the O1 restriction that only explainable AI/ML solutions are used, scoped to the service-critical part of O1's 'service-critical or human-related features'.

Expresses the O1 restriction that only explainable AI/ML solutions are used, scoped to the human-related part of O1's 'service-critical or human-related features' ('features relating to humans' preserves the meaning of 'human relating').
Directly expresses O2: the system provides the reasoning behind a given result when requested, preserving the request-triggered condition.
